{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm premises
assert (df['converted'] == 1).sum() > 0, "There must be at least one converted customer"
assert (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum() == 108, "108 missing ages (sentinel -1) confirmed"

# Filter for converted customers
converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where age is -1 (missing)
converted_valid = converted[converted['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")

# Output for evidence
mean_age"}
